description: This Java source file defines a REST controller for a receipt processing backend application, providing basic endpoints such as welcome, health check, documentation redirect, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic API endpoints for the receipt processing backend application.

methods.name: hello
